name: Compass Nav
description: A compass whose needle swings toward the destination under the pointer or the section in view, and whose dial turns to bring the chosen destination to the top.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; bearing?: number }[]
props.description: The destinations, placed round the dial at `bearing` degrees clockwise from north. Without bearings they are spread evenly. When an element with an item's id exists in the page (or in `container`), the needle follows that section while scrolling and choosing the item scrolls to it.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the chosen destination (controlled). It sits at the top of the dial, under the index mark.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The destination chosen first (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first item.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when another destination is chosen.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in pixels. It shrinks to fit narrower containers.

props.name: container
props.description: A scrolling element whose sections the needle follows, instead of the window.

props.name: needleColor
props.description: Colour of the needle's pointing end and the N on the dial.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu of destinations for assistive technology. Up and Down arrows move round the dial clockwise; Enter chooses.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. Other div props are passed through.
